subject: Structuring data ops towards Gen-5?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Saw that you still have not yet filled the Director of Machine Learning
position, who will be focused on ML Datasets Engineering ever since the
Series D announcement - congrats btw!

Seems like the focus moving forward will remain around structuring your
data ops pipelines for large scale multimodal datasets besides offering a
centralized environment for your teams to visualise experiments across the
business & bring new research (like Gen-5) to production faster.

We've seen this happen a few times for our partners in the space
(Synthesia, Captions, etc) and have built tooling to visualize, manage and
interact with petabyte-level of video & multimodal data smoothly.

Would be great to find some time to get your thoughts on these pieces -
would you be available to meet virtually next week?

subject: Multimodal Data ops for Automated Officiating
text:
Hey [NAME],

Not sure if you were part of the discussions with Cruise + Encord back in
the day but if this is the first time hearing about us, it's a pleasure to
meet you.

Saw the move to the NBA for the officiating project and wanted to reach
out. We're working very closely with the ML/CV teams at Hudl, MVP, Spiideo
and a few major leaders in Sports AI that I can't mention. Encord is the
leader in video annotation, curating and eval and we see the future as
truly multimodal so have invested a lot of engineering time to incorporate
these modalities in one platform.

If you're free at all tomorrow, i'd love to jump on a call and trade
introductions?
